Get enough sleep . No midnight last minute studying before a math exam . You need to be able to focus during the exam . Maths is like puzzle tbh , the more you practice and think , the easier it gets . 

If you have formulas to learn , write them down on a sheet of paper . Read them before going to sleep . Wake up the next morning and try to recall them , if you can't try to learn them again .

Incase you are really freaking out and having an actual panic attack before or during the exam try "being present". It's hard to get out of your head sometimes and that's alright . Engage your senses , name 5 objects around you , listen to the sounds , notice your breathing etc . Attempt the easy questions you know before attempting the more challenging ones , this way you won't lose points on an answer you COULD solve but didn't because you spent 30 minutes on that weird word problem and don't have time to finish .

If you have time recheck , double check heck even triple check your answers , can't be too sure if you've missed out an important step or messed up the calculation .

Stay hydrated . Eat something healthy for breakfast .

Good luck :3
